packageRules.description: Updates of GitHub Actions only change the CI. Use the `ci` type for them instead of `deps`, so that they are not added to the changelog.
The refs of this action are branches that select the Rust version. They cannot be updated like tags, and the version of the MSRV job must stay in sync with `rust-version` in Cargo.toml.

This action is maintained by the same organization as CoCoCheck, so its releases are adopted immediately instead of waiting for the minimum release age, which protects against broken or compromised releases of third parties.
